Scizor

Bug Steel

Johto · Generation 2

Scizor is a Bug/Steel-type Pincer Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 118 kg. It evolves from Scyther. Its highest base stat is Attack (130), with a base stat total of 500.
